notes: The public demo, not the tracker. Slug is congress-demo, not congress: /opt/sites/_vhosts/congress.conf is the production congress.noeinsolutions.com vhost and a slug of congress would overwrite it. Three containers: web (nginx serving the React build, the only one on the edge network) proxies /api, /admin and /robots.txt to api (FastAPI on the frozen snapshot, DEMO_MODE on, behind an email gate, on an internal network with no route out); mail-relay (on internal + egress) forwards to smtp0001.neo.space:587 and nowhere else, for the sign-in codes. The snapshot is unpacked into a tmpfs at start, so every restart serves the committed fixture; sign-ins live on the `access` named volume and must survive (never compose down -v). This replaces deploy/congress-demo-api.service, which ran the same process on the host beside the live API; a container needs no host checkout and cannot reach the live database at all. Secrets in /opt/sites/congress-demo/.env on the server, read by api only: APP_SESSION_SECRET, NEO_SMTP_HOST/PORT(587)/USER/PASS(single-quoted), EMAIL_FROM, DEMO_ADMIN_TOKEN, DEMO_NOTIFY_EMAIL. The api refuses to start without the mail lines, so the deploy rolls back until they are there. Deploy from the repo root with: bash ~/.claude/skills/hetzner-site/bin/site-deploy.sh (the root deploy.sh is the private tracker's wrapper, not this).
